metadata.title: A UMAP of every cell of Tahoe-100M (95,624,334 cells)
metadata.description:
Two-dimensional UMAP coordinates for all 95,624,334 cells of Tahoe-100M (Tahoe Therapeutics and the Arc Institute; Zhang et al., Cell 2026), keyed by the release's cell identifier BARCODE_SUB_LIB_ID and by row in the Hugging Face release's shard order, plus the ids of the reference cells the UMAP was fitted on.

Method: 50 principal components of log-normalised counts (2,000 most variable genes), every cell projected exactly; UMAP (umap-learn; n_neighbors=15, min_dist=0.3, euclidean, random_state=0) fitted on a reference sample of up to 1,430 cells from every plate x cell line stratum; every other cell placed at the inverse-distance-weighted mean of its 15 nearest reference cells in PC space (faiss IVF-Flat, recall 0.997 against exact search). The placed cells are an out-of-sample projection, not a joint UMAP of all cells.

Made for the AnnZarro manuscript (Otto, Baasri and Setty), which draws every cell of Tahoe-100M in a web browser. Scripts: github.com/settylab/annzarro-reproducibility, benchmark/scale/umap_tahoe.py and benchmark/scale/zenodo_umap.py. See README.md for file layout, checksums and how to join with Tahoe-100M.

The coordinates are released under CC BY 4.0; Tahoe-100M itself is CC0 1.0.
